CPU-only local language model inference involves running predictions on text data solely with the central processing unit (CPU) of your device without relying on graphics processing units (GPUs). Quantization reduces the precision of numbers used in calculations to save computational resources while maintaining acceptable accuracy levels, which helps improve tokens processed per second and memory usage. Tokens refer to discrete pieces or words that are analyzed by language models during inference tasks; higher token rates indicate faster performance under quantized conditions.
